# 🌍 Message for Faircoin Volunteers

Hello friends ✨

Thank you for joining the Faircoin Community Project 🪙
Here, everyone is both a volunteer and a leader — because every act of fairness is true leadership.

## 🕊️ Simple, Free Structure:

Time and position are flexible — each person contributes as they can.

Today you may code, tomorrow rest or do marketing — it's all fine.

You can join or leave anytime, freely.

Every contribution is recorded in the PFI★ (Personal Fairness Index) — a reflection of your growth and leadership.

All volunteers share leadership equally — no rigid hierarchy, only fairness.

## 📁 Contribution Guide:
👉 https://github.com/jonipwi/faircoin.app/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

Let's build this community in the spirit of fairness, love, and responsible freedom.
